description: NREL Solar Radiation is a data resource listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Public Data Resources > Energy and Natural Resources", published or maintained by as named on nsrdb.nrel.gov. The National Solar Radiation Database (NSRDB) is a serially complete collection of hourly and half-hourly values of meteorological data and the three most common measurements of solar radiation: global horizontal, direct normal and diffuse horizontal irradiance.
